Finsler metric measure spaces encompass a richer set of geometric tensors compared to Riemannian manifolds (cf. 11]). It is important to emphasize that (1.1) is not merely a quasilinear elliptic equation, as the underlying space is an anisotropic and asymmetric manifold.
